meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 收集系统全链路操作日志，生成可追溯的执行证据链与向量索引，是多智能体系统可观测性与安全审计的底座。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪多智能体系统全链路操作，生成可追溯证据链
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在构建多智能体系统时，需要记录操作日志并满足审计需求
copy.tagline_en: Track full-chain operations in multi-agent systems and generate traceable evidence chains
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build multi-agent systems that need operation logs and audit trails

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在关键操作节点记录操作事件，生成按 trace_id 串联的可追溯证据链和向量索引，并可按 trace_id、时间窗或官署维度检索历史证据。
howto.when: 当系统发生分发、扫描、解析等关键操作事件时触发，或通过事件总线异步推送进入。

say.text: 查询这个 trace_id 的证据链
检索最近一小时的操作记录
say.note: 按时间窗筛选出历史事件

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude records operation events at key nodes, builds a traceable evidence chain linked by trace_id and a vector index, and can retrieve historical evidence by trace_id, time window, or department.
howto.when_en: Triggered when key operation events such as dispatch, scan, or parse occur, or pushed asynchronously via the event bus.

say_en.text: Record the dispatch event just now
Query the evidence chain for this trace_id
Search operation records from the last hour
say_en.note: Filters historical events by time window
